Renamed from make_corners. ; ; ;- function red_make_corners, clip dim = size(clip,/dim) corners = intarr(4,3) if dim(0) gt 3 then begin corners(*,2) = 1 corners([0,2], 0) = clip(0) corners([1,3], 0) = clip(1) corners([0,1], 1) = clip(2) corners([2,3], 1) = clip(3) endif return, corners end
